notes.title: Lore Demo Patch 0.1.1
notes.notes:
A small patch for Lore demo has been released. Read the changes here:

Gameplay Adjustments:
- Slightly reduced the Hunter’s sight radius when player is sprinting
- Slightly reduced the sound made when sprinting
- Added a ‘reset’ button to code locks
- Added a pathway from the house to the workshop
- Added signs pointing towards the shed and the workshop
- Added tutorial pop ups that appear during the first few areas

Options:
- added a gamma slider
- Added a field of view slider

Bug Fixes:
- fixed issue where certain sounds are not affected by the volume settings
- Fixed issue where the mouse cursor would disappear when leaving the pause menu if the player is reading a note or in the inventory 
- Fixed getting stuck in the reading note screen when caught while widget is active
- Fixed the game skipping the opening when pressing continue while no save is active
- Fixed certain visual affects not playing on lower graphical settings
